say:1:1620110001:1.text: Professor, we'll hunt down the troublemaker for you. Please help Witstaff prepare for the exam!
say:1:1620110001:1.source_cn: 教授，我们答应帮你调查那个在墓地捣蛋的人，请你帮维茨瓦...

say:2:1620110002:1.text: But the problem is, we hardly have any clues right now. Have you seen the culprit? Any notable features?
say:2:1620110002:1.source_cn: 不过，现在线索实在太少了。你有没有见过这个犯人，他有什...

say:3:1620110003:1.text: If I'd seen the culprit, why would I need your help?
say:3:1620110003:1.source_cn: 我要是见过犯人，还找你们调查干什么？

say:4:1620110004:1.text: Not much I can tell you. For the past month, someone's been bouncing around my grave at night, and I can't rest at all.
say:4:1620110004:1.source_cn: 我能提供的线索不多。作乱事件是在一个月前开始的，一到晚...

say:5:1620110005:1.text: I got so fed up that I crawled out of my grave to catch the culprit, but every time I showed up, they bolted. I couldn't even get a glimpse at their face.
say:5:1620110005:1.source_cn: 气得我变成幽灵爬出来想要抓人，可每次我一出现，那个人就...

say:6:1620110006:1.text: Hmm... Someone showing up here every night for a month can't have left nothing behind.
say:6:1620110006:1.source_cn: 唔……虽说如此，但这个人连续一个月晚上跑来墓园，多少会...

say:7:1620110007:1.text: I concur. Every mark could be an important lead.
say:7:1620110007:1.source_cn: 没错，这些踪迹都是珍贵的线索。

say:8:1620110008:1.text: Since I'm stuck here, I'm counting on you guys to get to the bottom of this.
say:8:1620110008:1.source_cn: 我不能离开墓碑，调查的事就交给你们了。

say:9:1620110009:1.text: Chippy had a look around, and everything seemed normal... How do we even begin?
say:9:1620110009:1.source_cn: 满满刚刚看了一圈，这里就是很正常的墓园……要从哪里开始...

say:10:1620110010:1.text: Let's <style="highlight">approach the folks nearby</style>. Maybe we can find an eyewitness.
say:10:1620110010:1.source_cn: 先去<style=highlight>问问墓园周围的人...

say:13:1620110011:1.text: Count me in! I may fumble with magic, but my sleuthing skills are solid!
say:13:1620110011:1.source_cn: 我也来帮忙！别看我这样，调查推理能力还是很靠谱的！
